Telemetry_Info_Message:
This feature sends anonymous data to help improve RagnaKontroller:

• App version and operating system
• Crash reports with stack traces
• Basic usage statistics (no personal data)

Nei sensitive information like usernames, passwords, or game progress is collected.

Data is sent via Discord Webhook for easy monitoring.

Tut.1_Desc: Welcome to RagnaKontroller! This tutorial will help you get started.
Tut_2_Desc: Tired of missing tiny items? When you open your inventory, use the D-Krydspad to snap the cursor perfectly from slot to slot. Trykk 'A' to double-click and equip items instantly.
Tut_3_Desc: Casting Storm Gust har aldri vært enklere. Hold ned ferdighetsknappen (f.eks. L1+A).
Tut_4_Desc: Having trouble clicking on a fast-moving Poring? Just tilt the Høyre Stick slightly towards the monster and click R3. The engine will fire a micro-spiral click, guaranteeing a hit on the hitbox.
Tut_5_Desc: Need complex combos? Opptak your key presses, then open the Visual Timeline Redigeror. You can drag and drop the delays perfectly to match the server's lag and your character's ASPD.
